channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Hawaii's Holei Sea Arch Collapses Into Pacific Ocean
item.description: Hawaii's Holei Sea Arch, a lava rock formation estimated to be 550 years old, has collapsed into the Pacific Ocean. The natural wonder, located in Volcanoes National Park, crumbled sometime last weekend. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Tornado damages Ulladulla during severe storm
item.description: A tornado has swept through Ulladulla, New South Wales, Australia, amidst severe storms that also affected Sydney. Reports describe the event as "crazy". Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Food Program Warns of Devastating Hunger Crisis in Yemen
item.description: The UN's World Food Program (WFP) has issued a warning about an accelerating hunger crisis in Yemen, describing the situation as potentially 'absolutely devastating'. The agency's alert comes amid escalating regional conflict. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Floods in Spain Kill Elderly Woman, Trap Dozens
item.description: Heavy showers and storms across Spain this weekend have resulted in fatal flooding, killing a 102-year-old woman and trapping approximately 90 people. Drone footage has been used to reveal the scale of the devastation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Reclaims Landfill Sites, Plans Waste Processing Units
item.description: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta announced the reclamation of 100 acres from landfill sites and laid the foundation for waste processing units at three locations. Gupta took a "last selfie" with the Okhla garbage mountain, vowing to end… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Man Dies After Injury from Air-Dropped Relief Package in Bihar Floods
item.description: During flood relief operations in Bihar, a 65-year-old man was struck by a relief packet dropped from an Indian Air Force helicopter and later died from his injuries. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: India's Monsoon Season Ends With Significant Rainfall Deficit
item.description: India's monsoon season concluded with a rainfall deficit of 12.6%, making it the fourth-lowest rainfall recorded since 2001. Fifteen states and Union Territories experienced below-normal rainfall during the season. The deficit was reported… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Heavy Rain Triggers Flooding in Bangkok and Raises Flood Risks in Texas
item.description: Thailand's meteorological agency forecast heavy to very heavy rain across several regions, and the resulting downpours turned Bangkok's streets into canals, prompting thousands to seek shelter and causing flood damage estimated at over… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Tigress Reintroduced to Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve
item.description: A three-year-old tigress, brought from the Valmiki Tiger Reserve, has been released into the Buxa Tiger Reserve in West Bengal. The tigress is reportedly healthy and has settled in, consuming 10kg of meat. Plans are underway to release… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Super El Niño Threatens LA Sewage Plant, NOAA Cuts Research
item.description: A 'super' El Niño event poses a potential threat to Los Angeles's aging Hyperion sewage treatment plant, with the possibility of overwhelming its capacity. Concurrently, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) is scaling… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New Islands Emerge Near Indonesia's Anak Krakatau Volcano After Eruption
item.description: Two new islands have appeared near Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano following an eruption. Satellite images captured the islands within the water-filled caldera where the volcano is located. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal to Drain Glacial Lakes Due to Flood Risks
item.description: Nepal plans to drain four glacial lakes following deadly floods that have occurred in the region. The initiative aims to mitigate rising flood risks associated with these glacial bodies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ladakh Cultivates Saffron on Barren High-Altitude Plateau
item.description: An experiment to cultivate saffron is underway on Ladakh's high-altitude cold desert plateau, a region previously considered unsuitable for such growth. The initiative aims to introduce purple and saffron-colored flora to the barren… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Avalanche in Nepal's Himalayas kills at least 14, leaves others missing
item.description: An avalanche at the Himlung Himal Base Camp in Nepal has resulted in the deaths of at least 14 Nepali workers and left 10 to 14 others missing. The incident occurred while workers were preparing the mountain camp for climbers. Rescuers… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 1.

item.title: Western Europe Records Hottest Summer with Thousands of Heat Deaths
item.description: Western Europe experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026, with more than half of the continent facing intense heat stress, according to an EU monitor. The extreme heat resulted in an estimated 34,600 deaths across Western Europe… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Swiss glaciers lose significant ice mass in recent years
item.description: Swiss glaciers have lost a fifth of their ice mass in the past five years, a phenomenon described as 'catastrophic'. This rapid melting is evident in the astonishing amount of ice being lost from the country's glaciers. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Coastal Walking Trails Face Climate Change Threat
item.description: Coastal walking trails are increasingly at risk due to climate change, with rising sea levels and extreme weather events threatening their stability and accessibility. The Sydney Morning Herald reported on the precarious state of these… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Implements Winter Pollution Control Measures
item.description: Delhi authorities have introduced a series of measures to combat air pollution ahead of winter. These include a 50% work-from-home mandate for government employees, a doubling of parking charges, staggered office timings, and a ban on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Chennai Home Buyers Prioritize Flood Risk Amid Extreme Weather
item.description: Home buyers in Chennai are increasingly factoring flood risk into their purchasing decisions, a trend amplified by recent extreme weather events. This heightened awareness is influencing preferences, with a notable shift towards larger… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab brings heavy rain to Chhattisgarh, breaks records
item.description: Cyclone Arnab caused severe weather in Chhattisgarh, with 60 mm of rain recorded in 24 hours. Jagdalpur saw rainfall records broken for the last 6 years, while Raipur's rainfall record for the past 2 years was also broken. An alert has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Bangkok Residents Navigate Flooded Markets Amidst Daily Life
item.description: Daily life persists in Bangkok as residents are seen navigating waist-deep floodwaters, with some using kayaks to reach markets. The coverage focuses on the continuation of everyday activities despite the significant flooding. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Thames Water Pipe Bursts, Affecting Thousands in London
item.description: A burst water main operated by Thames Water in London has caused water outages and low pressure for approximately 6,000 properties across seven boroughs. The leak was reportedly discharging 750 liters per second, leading to the closure of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal landslide causes river to swell, threatening downstream areas
item.description: A large landslide caused a mountain to collapse into the Narayani river in Nepal, leading the river to cross its danger level. The swelling river poses a risk to areas downstream, including along the Gandak region. The event occurred in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Nepal Floods and Landslides Cause Widespread Destruction
item.description: Heavy monsoon rains have triggered severe floods and landslides across Nepal, resulting in at least 24 reported deaths. The disaster has caused widespread destruction, with videos showing the extent of the devastation. The events in Nepal… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Heavy rains kill 56 in Uttar Pradesh, damage over 1,000 houses
item.description: At least 56 people died and over 1,000 houses were damaged in Uttar Pradesh over a 48-hour period due to heavy rainfall. The opposition has criticized the government's response to the situation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Nepal Rains Cause Floods, Landslides, Killing 27
item.description: Heavy rains in Nepal have led to widespread floods and landslides, resulting in at least 27 deaths and seven injuries. The disasters have affected multiple areas since September 24, with impacts also extending to bordering Indian states. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mandakini River Rises Above Danger Mark in Chitrakoot, Four Dead in Kanpur-Bundelkhand
item.description: The Mandakini River in Chitrakoot has risen above the danger mark, prompting the administration to go on high alert. In the Kanpur-Bundelkhand region, four people have died due to the rising water levels. The river has previously shown a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Deep Depression Brings Heavy Rain and Flood Alerts Across Eastern India
item.description: The India Meteorological Department issued a red‑warning alert for the Odisha districts of Kalahandi, Nabarangpur, Koraput and Malkangiri as a deep depression moved across the Andhra‑Odisha coast. The system produced 28 cm of rain in… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 13 · Right 4.

item.title: Sikkim landslide damages houses in Rimbi village
item.description: Heavy rain in Sikkim's Rimbi village caused a landslide and flash flood threat, damaging 32 houses. The Chief Minister took action following the event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Polo Intensifies Rapidly Due to El Niño
item.description: Hurricane Polo, located off the Mexican coast, has experienced explosive growth and is described as one of the strongest storms ever in its region. The intensification of Hurricane Polo is attributed to the El Niño weather pattern, which… Coverage: Left 6 · Centre 10 · Right 0.

item.title: Musi Project Reservoir Nears Full Capacity, Flood Alert Issued
item.description: An alert has been issued for the Musi Project reservoir as its water level is nearing full capacity. The Musi catchment areas in Nalgonda and Suryapet districts have been specifically mentioned in the flood alert. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sea Turtle Lays Eggs on California Beach
item.description: A tropical sea turtle has laid eggs on a Southern California beach, marking the first recorded instance of such nesting on the West Coast. Scientists have documented this event. Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Weather forecasts for Lethbridge and Boston on September 23, 2026
item.description: CTV News reported that the temperature in Lethbridge, Alberta, is expected to be 5°C on Wednesday, September 23, 2026. CBS News published a midday weather forecast for Boston on the same date, without specifying a temperature. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indonesia Wildfires Cause Haze, Respiratory Illnesses
item.description: Wildfires in Indonesia have led to a persistent cycle of fires and haze, affecting Sumatra and causing transboundary haze. More than 170,000 respiratory cases, including coughs and pneumonia, have been recorded in haze-choked Indonesia… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: September Heat Records Broken in India and US
item.description: In September 2026, Barmer in Rajasthan recorded temperatures above 42 °C, breaking the September heat record for the city. In the United States, a rare September heat dome set a 99‑year weather record as temperatures approached 104 °F… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Environmentalist Bittu Tabahi Cleans Yamuna River Bank in Delhi
item.description: Environmentalist Bittu Sahgal, also known as Bittu Tabahi, conducted a cleanup mission along the Yamuna river bank in Delhi. In 4.5 hours, he and local volunteers removed 585 kg of waste from the riverbank. The mission extended from the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Polo Intensifies to Category 5 Storm
item.description: Hurricane Polo has rapidly intensified into a Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast. It is expected to bring heavy rain to parts of southwestern Mexico, including Guerrero and Michoacán, through Thursday. The storm's rapid… Coverage: Left 6 · Centre 16 · Right 0.

item.title: Monsoon Withdraws From Delhi After Shortest Spell in 14 Years
item.description: The Southwest Monsoon has withdrawn from Delhi, marking the shortest spell in 14 years. The withdrawal occurred two days ahead of the normal date. The earliest withdrawal of the Southwest Monsoon from Delhi on record was in 1982, which was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Couple Survives Nepal Floods After Last-Minute Trip Change
item.description: Mita and Hemant Parikh, a couple from Suwanee, Georgia, in the US, survived Nepal floods that killed 1,400 people. They were on a pilgrimage in the country when the disaster occurred. The couple had decided to take a side trip, splitting… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Super El Niño may cause 450,000 deaths, 15,800 in India, researchers say
item.description: Researchers from the Climate Impact Lab at the University of Chicago estimate that the current 'Super' El Niño could lead to about 450,000 excess deaths worldwide, with the highest mortality expected in poorer nations that are already… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 10 · Right 1.
